name: therapyportal-mcp
description: Use a TherapyNotes client portal (TherapyPortal) — upcoming appointments, paperwork, practice forms, balances, receipts and secure messages, document and receipt downloads, plus confirm-gated secure messages and document uploads — by signing in server-side with your portal password, or by relaying through your signed-in browser tab.

tools.name: therapyportal_list_clients
tools.description: The clients (patients) linked to this portal login, with the PatientId the other tools take. Names and date of birth only.

tools.name: therapyportal_list_appointments
tools.description: Upcoming therapy appointments: date and time, clinician, telehealth or in-person location, and which client. The portal lists future appointments only.

tools.name: therapyportal_list_documents
tools.description: Paperwork the practice sent (pending, completed or all): each request and its documents, with status, dates and the ids therapyportal_download_document takes.

tools.name: therapyportal_list_forms
tools.description: The practice's always-available forms and documents (to sign or upload as needed), per client.

tools.name: therapyportal_get_document_counts
tools.description: Per client: how many portal documents are waiting to be completed or approved, by clinical, administrative and billing category.

tools.name: therapyportal_list_balances
tools.description: The amount due to the practice for each client, and whether autopay is on.

tools.name: therapyportal_list_receipts
tools.description: Payment receipts: date, amount, and the dates of service each payment covered. Returns the PaymentId therapyportal_download_receipt takes.

tools.name: therapyportal_list_message_threads
tools.description: Secure-message conversations for one client. Listing does not mark anything read.

tools.name: therapyportal_get_thread_messages
tools.description: The messages in one secure-message conversation. Does not mark the conversation read.

tools.name: therapyportal_download_document
tools.description: Download a completed portal document as a file: a form the client filled in (rendered to PDF) or a file the practice uploaded. Saves to disk locally or returns the bytes inline when hosted.

tools.name: therapyportal_download_receipt
tools.description: Download a payment receipt as a PDF, by PaymentId from therapyportal_list_receipts. Saves to disk locally or returns the bytes inline when hosted.

tools.name: therapyportal_list_message_topics
tools.description: The secure-message topics one client can write to (the topic_id therapyportal_send_message takes, and whether each reaches clinical, billing or administrative staff), whether secure messaging is on, and whether the client has an assigned clinician. Changes nothing.

tools.name: therapyportal_send_message
tools.description: Start a new secure-message conversation with the practice for one client, under a topic. The practice receives it and it cannot be unsent, so it is confirm-gated: the first call returns a preview and a confirmToken, and only a repeat call with that token sends.

tools.name: therapyportal_reply_message
tools.description: Reply in an existing secure-message conversation. Confirm-gated (preview + confirmToken) and cannot be unsent; leaves the conversation's read state alone unless mark_thread_read is true.

tools.name: therapyportal_upload_document
tools.description: Upload a local PDF, JPG, PNG, HEIC or DOCX (up to 25 MB) in answer to a pending document request or an upload-required always-available form. Confirm-gated (preview + confirmToken); the practice receives the file and it cannot be removed here. Refuses anything that needs a signature.

tools.name: therapyportal_healthcheck
tools.description: Report portal connectivity from whichever transport is live: the server-side sign-in, or the browser bridge. Skipped when no credential resolves.

therapyportal_practice.title: Practice code
therapyportal_practice.description: Your practice's portal code: the part after /p/ in its TherapyPortal URL (www.therapyportal.com/p/<code>/).

therapyportal_email.title: Portal email
therapyportal_email.description: The email you sign in to TherapyPortal with. Set with the password to sign in server-side; leave both empty to relay through your signed-in browser tab.

therapyportal_password.title: Portal password
therapyportal_password.description: Your TherapyPortal password. A rejected sign-in is never retried automatically.

therapyportal_dob.title: Date of birth (sign-in check)
therapyportal_dob.description: Only if the portal asks for a date of birth at sign-in: that date, as MM/DD/YYYY. Tried once; never retried, because the portal limits attempts.

therapyportal_transport.title: Transport (advanced)
therapyportal_transport.description: server or fetchproxy. Default: server when email and password are both set, otherwise fetchproxy.

therapyportal_ws_port.title: fetchproxy port (advanced)
therapyportal_ws_port.description: fetchproxy concentrator port (fetchproxy transport only, default 37149). The whole fleet shares this one port; override only when hosting.

therapyportal_output_dir.title: Download directory (advanced)
therapyportal_output_dir.description: Where downloaded files are written on the server transport (a path-delimiter list; ~ expands). Default ~/Downloads and ~/Documents. A per-call dest must resolve inside one of these.

therapyportal_inline_downloads.title: Inline downloads (advanced)
therapyportal_inline_downloads.description: true returns downloaded bytes inline (base64) instead of writing to disk, for a hosted runner whose disk you cannot reach. Default false.

therapyportal_upload_dir.title: Upload directory (advanced)
therapyportal_upload_dir.description: Folders a file may be uploaded from (a path-delimiter list; ~ expands). Default ~/Downloads, ~/Documents and ~/Desktop; $MCP_DATA_DIR/uploads when hosted. An upload's file_path must resolve inside one of these.

mcp_confirm_mode.title: Confirm mode (advanced)
mcp_confirm_mode.description: Confirm-gate behaviour for every write (messages, uploads). ask-user (default) returns a preview + confirmToken and needs a second call with that token; auto lets a capable host confirm in one step; an unrecognised value fails closed (refuse).

mcp_confirm_elicitation.title: Confirm by prompt (advanced)
mcp_confirm_elicitation.description: on (default) lets the host confirm a write interactively; off forces the confirmToken round-trip.

fetchproxy_ws_host.title: fetchproxy bind address (advanced)
fetchproxy_ws_host.description: Bind interface for the fetchproxy concentrator, a literal IP only (default 127.0.0.1). Keep on loopback; it exists for hosted deployments that run each MCP in its own network namespace.

fetchproxy_identity_dir.title: fetchproxy identity directory (advanced)
fetchproxy_identity_dir.description: Absolute path where the fetchproxy long-term identity keypair is stored (default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/).
